dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご相談で来られましたか？
dialogue.English: Hello. What brings you in for a consultation today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 子供のことでご相談をお願いします
dialogue.English: I'd like to consult with you about my child.

dialogue.content: ご相談ありがとうございます。まず初めに、性別、年齢、お住まいの都道府県を教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you for consulting with us. First, could you please tell me your gender, age, and the prefecture you live in?

dialogue.content: 東京都35歳女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 35-year-old woman living in Tokyo.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お子さんについてのご相談ですね。どのようなことをお聞きになりたいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, this is about your child. What specifically would you like to ask?

dialogue.content: 息子が学校に行くのを嫌がるようになってしまってどのようにすればよいのか困っています
dialogue.English: My son has started refusing to go to school, and I’m at a loss as to what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは親として大変ですよね‥
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult for you as a parent.

dialogue.content: お子さんの年齢と学年を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me your son's age and grade?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 14歳中学2年生です
dialogue.English: He's 14 years old and in his second year of junior high school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。息子さんが学校に行くのを嫌がるようになったのはいつからですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. When did your son start refusing to go to school?

dialogue.content: 5月の連休明けからです
dialogue.English: It started after the long holiday in May.

dialogue.content: 今月に入ってからということですね。そのことについて、息子さんとお話しはできていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: So it's been since the beginning of this month. Have you been able to talk with your son about it?

dialogue.content: 朝起こしにいってもベッドから出てこないんです
dialogue.English: Even when I go to wake him up in the morning, he won't get out of bed.

dialogue.content: 何度も何度も声をかけても出てこなくて
dialogue.English: I call out to him over and over, but he won't come out.

dialogue.content: どうしたのか聞いても
dialogue.English: Even when I ask him what's wrong...

dialogue.content: 普段から余りに話しくれなくて
dialogue.English: He usually doesn't talk to me much at all,

dialogue.content: 話してくれなくてですね
dialogue.English: he just won't open up.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。お話ししてくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 息子さんが話そうとしてくれない状況はお辛いですよね‥
dialogue.English: It must be painful for you when your son won't open up to you.

dialogue.content: 時期もあるのかなとも思うんですけど
dialogue.English: I wonder if it's just a phase he's going through.

dialogue.content: 確かにその可能性もありますね。
dialogue.English: That’s certainly a possibility.

dialogue.content: 5月の連休前までは部活のサッカーに夢中だったんです
dialogue.English: Until the long May holiday, he was really into his soccer club.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 連休明けはサッカーへの取り組む様子が変わったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Did his attitude toward soccer change after the holiday?

dialogue.content: 何があっとのかと聞いてもホントにムスッとした顔してうるせー!と部屋から出ていってしまって
dialogue.English: When I ask him what happened, he just gets a sullen look on his face, yells, "Shut up!" and storms out of the room.

dialogue.content: 今は学校に行かないからサッカーからも離れています
dialogue.English: Now that he's not going to school, he's also distanced himself from soccer.

dialogue.content: 今はサッカーからも離れてしまっているのですね。
dialogue.English: So he has distanced himself from soccer for now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 心配してても心を開いてくれない状況はお辛いですよね
dialogue.English: It must be very hard when you're so worried, but he won't open up to you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです主人はほっとけば良いと言っているし
dialogue.English: Exactly. And my husband says we should just leave him be.

dialogue.content: でも勉強も気になりますし
dialogue.English: But I'm also worried about his studies.

dialogue.content: ご主人は現状、協力的ではないんですね。息子さんへのお悩みはどなたかにお話しはできましたか？
dialogue.English: So your husband isn't being very cooperative at the moment. Have you been able to talk to anyone else about your concerns for your son?

dialogue.content: 学校へ行ってない分、勉強面も気になりますよね
dialogue.English: Since he's not going to school, it's natural to be concerned about his studies.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生が気にしてくださり、3日に一度電話でお話をしています
dialogue.English: His homeroom teacher is concerned and calls me every three days to talk.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生とは息子さんについてお話しされていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: So you've been speaking with his homeroom teacher about your son.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生は、なんとおっしゃっているのですか？
dialogue.English: What has the homeroom teacher been saying?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 今まではやる気満々で元気だったのにどうしたのかとか
dialogue.English: Things like, 'He was always so motivated and energetic, what could have happened?'

dialogue.content: クラスの友達にも話を聞いてくれているようです
dialogue.English: It seems he's also talking to my son's friends in the class.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: いま、一番お辛いと感じていることはなんですか？
dialogue.English: Right now, what feels most difficult for you?

dialogue.content: 息子が学校に行かずにいるのを見ているのが辛いです将来も不安になってしまいます
dialogue.English: It's painful to see my son not going to school. It makes me anxious about his future.

dialogue.content: そうですよね‥目の前で見ていてとても不安なお気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.English: That's understandable. Seeing it happen right in front of you must make you feel very anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今お抱えの不安を解消するために、まずできそうなことは何だとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: To help alleviate the anxiety you're feeling now, what do you think is a possible first step?

dialogue.content: 息子はなぜ行かなくなったのか、知ることができれば解決できるのかなと思います
dialogue.English: I think if I could find out why he stopped going, we might be able to solve this.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。学校へ行かなくなった理由について、知っていきたいですよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. You'd like to understand the reason he stopped going to school.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その点については担任の先生とお話しできていらっしゃいますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you been able to discuss that point with his homeroom teacher?

dialogue.content: クラスの友達にも話を聞いてくれているとのことですけど
dialogue.English: He said he's been talking to his friends in the class, but...

dialogue.content: これということはわからないらしいんです
dialogue.English: Apparently, nothing specific has come up.

dialogue.content: 私も仕事を持っているので
dialogue.English: I also have a job, so...

dialogue.content: 朝仕事に行く前に声をかけているだけなんです
dialogue.English: I just call out to him in the morning before I leave for work.

dialogue.content: 夜もどうしても遅くなりがちだし
dialogue.English: and I tend to get home late at night as well.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。お仕事も忙しい中で、息子さんとお話しするチャンスも限られていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So with your busy work schedule, your opportunities to talk with your son are also limited.
